## Summary

What does this change and why?

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (`fix:`)
- [ ] New feature (`feat:`)
- [ ] Breaking change (`feat!:` / `BREAKING CHANGE:`)
- [ ] Docs / chore / refactor / tests

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:e2e` pass locally
- [ ] Tests added or updated for the change
- [ ] Docs updated (`docs/`, README) for public API/CLI changes
- [ ] Retrieval/context output stays deterministic (stable sorts, no wall-clock in output)
- [ ] Benchmarks included for performance-sensitive changes (`npm run bench`)

## Notes for reviewers

Trade-offs, follow-ups, anything needing extra attention.
